title: microSD write failure
fullDescription: Insta360 ONE X3, X4, ONE RS, and Ace Pro shoot dual 5.7K/8K streams that demand V30+ cards. Slow or counterfeit cards trigger storage errors mid-record.

fixSteps.title: Switch to recommended card
fixSteps.instruction: SanDisk Extreme V30 or Insta360 official list.

title: 360 stitch rendering error
shortDescription: Studio or app could not stitch a 360 clip.
fullDescription: Dual-lens stitching can fail due to corrupt .insv file, mismatched lens calibration, or missing gyro data. Re-import, re-calibrate, or stitch with Insta360 Studio desktop.

fixSteps.title: Run lens calibration
fixSteps.instruction: Camera settings > Lens calibration, follow prompts.

title: Battery depletes too fast
shortDescription: Battery at end of life or cold-affected.
fullDescription: Dual 5.7K streams eat battery fast. After ~500 cycles, capacity drops significantly. Genuine replacements and warming in cold restore runtime.

fixSteps.title: Use genuine spare
fixSteps.instruction: Insta360 sells pack-specific batteries; multi-charger speeds swaps.

faq.a: X4 improved low-temperature runtime vs X3.

title: FlowState stabilization disabled
shortDescription: Firmware or mode combo blocks FlowState.
fullDescription: FlowState horizon lock is tied to resolution and fps. Bullet Time, TimeShift, and some interval modes disable it. Choose a supported mode to re-enable.

faq.a: Yes, Studio can apply FlowState during export.

title: Insta360 app cannot connect or import
fullDescription: Local-network permissions on iOS/Android, weak 5GHz signal, or app version mismatch cause sync failures. Grant permissions, update app, use wired transfer for large 8K files.

fixSteps.title: Grant permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > Insta360 > Local Network ON.

faq.a: X4 and Ace Pro support 5GHz; X3 2.4GHz only.

title: Thermal shutdown
shortDescription: Long high-res sessions reach thermal limit.
fullDescription: 8K 30p on X4 and 4K 120p on Ace Pro generate heat. A warning precedes shutdown; moving to shade and cooler ambient restores recording.

faq.q: Does dive case make it worse?
faq.a: Yes, reduces heat dissipation; limit takes.

title: Visible scratch or damage on dome lens
fullDescription: ONE X3/X4 have user-replaceable lenses. Insta360 sells replacement kits; the app detects some damage and suggests replacement.

fixSteps.title: Follow guided replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Use included tool to unscrew and replace both lenses.

whenToCallPro: If unsure about calibration after swap.

faq.a: Run lens calibration in-camera after swap.

title: OTA update interrupted
fullDescription: Low battery or Wi-Fi dropout interrupts firmware updates. Use the manual method — place firmware file on SD card root, boot camera with full battery.

fixSteps.title: Manual SD update
fixSteps.instruction: Copy firmware.bin to SD root, insert, power on.

whenToCallPro: If camera bricked after manual attempt.

faq.a: Insta360 posts betas on community forum.

displayCode: Go 3/Go 3S lost link to Action Pod
title: Action Pod connection lost
shortDescription: Pod loses Wi-Fi link with the camera.
fullDescription: Go 3/3S Action Pod uses 5GHz for live preview; interference, range, or low pod battery drops the link. Reduce distance, avoid crowded Wi-Fi, update firmware.
videoSearchQuery: Insta360 Go 3 Action Pod lost link fix

faq.a: Yes, Go 3/3S records standalone to internal storage.

title: Deep Track / AI subject detection dropped
shortDescription: AI reframe or track lost subject.
fullDescription: Deep Track 3.0 in Studio can lose lock on fast, small, or occluded subjects. Keyframing or re-selecting target restores tracking.

fixSteps.title: Add keyframes
fixSteps.instruction: In Studio timeline, add manual keyframes at loss points.
